tool_args.title: Taskmaster Agent Capabilities and Skillset
tool_args.content:
Taskmaster Autonomous Agent Engine - Skillset Overview

1. Content Creation & Documentation:
- Google Docs: Drafting professional reports, project proposals, and technical documentation.
- Google Sheets: Data analysis, project tracking, and complex spreadsheet modeling.
- Gmail: Automated email communication, scheduling, and correspondence management.

2. Project Management & Engineering:
- Jira: Full lifecycle management including epic creation, user story definition, and sprint planning.
- GitHub: Version control operations, issue tracking, and pull request management.

3. Web & Data Operations:
- Browser Controller: Autonomous web navigation, data extraction from complex DOM structures, and form interaction.
- Data Extraction: Parsing unstructured data into structured formats (JSON, CSV).
- Webhooks: Triggering external API workflows and integration pipelines.

4. Media & OS Control:
- Media Controller: YouTube and Spotify integration for search, playback, and playlist management.
- OS Desktop: Application launching, screen capture, and system-level automation.

5. Scheduling & Coordination:
- Google Calendar: Event management, availability checks, and meeting coordination.
- Slack: Automated reporting, team alerts, and communication synchronization.

6. Logic & Validation:
- Python Sandbox: Secure execution of data processing scripts and algorithmic tasks.
- Validator: Automated quality assurance and anomaly detection for all generated artifacts.

steps.reasoning: Creating a formal document provides a structured, readable, and persistent reference for the user regarding my capabilities.
